notes: Each πάντα is anarthrous, so rule 17's generic-noun clause holds and the head is *all*; rule 102 would move the head to *things* only where a Greek article governed the phrase, and none does here.
The four verb-plus-quantifier pairs are analysed identically across the verse, per rule 24.
The ASV's alternative-rendering note (*covereth*) bears on the gloss of στέγει only and changes no unit.
